From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, susan@peopleco.com
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Lead succession and handover — request for approval

Hi Laura / Vivek,

Quick summary: Ana (Engineering Lead, Search) is relocating to APAC and will start a three-month leave effective 03/22. I recommend Evelyn cover as acting manager for Ana's team (5 ICs) during the interim while we complete the permanent assignment. Evelyn has expressed willingness and has capacity based on current project plans.

Ask: please confirm approval so I can (1) update reporting lines, (2) kick off the HR transfer packet, and (3) schedule 1:1 handover sessions with Ana + team. I cc'd PeopleCo for any HR-side input on compensation/notice.

Notes:
- Proposed effective date: 2026-03-22
- Duration: 3 months, revisit earlier if hiring completes
- Impact: no headcount change, we may need short-term re-prioritization for Search infra work

I attached an org sketch and a handover checklist. If approved, I will create the DocuSign approval and the Jira task for tracking.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Search Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Lead succession and handover — request for approval

Marcus —

Thanks for the heads up. High level OK to the interim assignment; I want to confirm two things before formal sign-off:

1) Confirm there are no pending promotions or performance actions for any direct reports that would complicate reporting changes.
2) Can you route the org-chart + headcount confirmation to Finance (cc me) so we have month-end visibility?

If both are clear, please proceed with the HR packet and send me the DocuSign for final approval. Appreciate the handover checklist — useful.
